title: Find a pair of matching transaction amounts
prompt: Return the indices [i, j] (i < j) of two different elements whose sum equals target. Exactly one valid pair exists. Indices refer to the original input.
constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100000; signed integers; do not modify nums.
hints: Track earlier values by their index.
Before storing the current number, look for its complement.

title: Group request tokens by letter composition
prompt: Group strings that are anagrams of one another. Within each group sort words alphabetically, then sort groups by their first word. Preserve duplicate words. The empty string is valid.
hints: Anagrams share a canonical representation.
Sort letters to create a dictionary key.

title: Locate the first unique event marker
prompt: Return the zero-based position of the first character that appears exactly once in text, or -1 if none exists. Comparisons are case-sensitive.
hints: Count occurrences before choosing an index.
A dictionary avoids checking every later character again.

title: Check nested configuration delimiters
prompt: Return True when a string of round, square and curly brackets is properly matched and nested; otherwise False. The empty string is balanced.
hints: Track the most recently unmatched opening bracket.
A closing bracket must match the top of a stack.

title: First alert timestamp at or above threshold
prompt: Given a nondecreasing integer array, return the first index where nums[index] >= threshold; return len(nums) when all values are smaller. Do not linearly scan.
hints: The answer is a boundary rather than an exact equality match.
Keep a half-open search interval and shrink toward the leftmost valid position.

title: Combine sorted audit offsets
prompt: Merge sorted integer lists a and b into one nondecreasing list. Keep all duplicates and leave both inputs unchanged.
hints: Each array already has the required ordering.
Advance the pointer from the side with the smaller next value.

title: Largest consecutive net gain
prompt: Return the maximum sum over all nonempty contiguous subarrays. If every number is negative, return the largest (least negative) number.
hints: Focus on the best subarray that ends at each position.
At a new position either extend the previous run or restart.

title: Rotate on-call assignments
prompt: Return a new array formed by rotating nums right by k positions. Handle k larger than the array length; an empty input stays empty.
hints: Reduce the rotation count before slicing.
The last k elements become the first k after rotation.

title: Most frequent error labels
prompt: Return the k most frequent distinct lowercase labels ordered by descending frequency, breaking ties alphabetically. k is valid.
constraints: 1 <= len(labels) <= 100000; 1 <= k <= number of distinct labels.
hints: Counting alone does not define how to break ties.
Sort by a pair: negative frequency and alphabetic label.

title: Recover a missing sequence ID
prompt: An array holds n distinct numbers from 0 through n, missing exactly one. Return the missing number; an empty array means zero is missing.
hints: Compare the full range against the observed values.
The arithmetic series provides the expected sum without sorting.

title: Check a one-to-one masking map
prompt: Return True if every character of source maps consistently to exactly one character of masked and no two source characters share the same mapped character. Lengths must match.
hints: A forward mapping is necessary but may not be sufficient.
Check consistency in both directions.

title: Square ordered temperature offsets
prompt: Given a nondecreasing array, return the squares in nondecreasing order. Do not call a sorting function on the output.
hints: The extremes have the largest absolute values.
Fill the result from the rightmost index backward.

title: Common items across sorted inventories
prompt: Return the nondecreasing multiset intersection of sorted integer lists a and b. Each value should occur the minimum of its multiplicities in both lists.
hints: Sorted lists let you skip values without scanning everything.
Only move both pointers on an equal pair.

title: Compact nonzero sensor values
prompt: Return a new array with all nonzero elements in their original relative order followed by all zeroes. Do not modify the input.
hints: Preserve the order of useful entries.
The number of trailing zeroes is the original length minus the number of nonzero values.

title: Longest shared route prefix
prompt: Return the longest prefix shared by every string in paths. If paths is empty, return "". Matching is case-sensitive.
hints: One string can act as an initial candidate.
Shorten the candidate whenever a later string does not start with it.

title: Product of metrics excluding current
prompt: Return result[i] equal to the product of all nums[j] for j != i. Do not use division. Arrays may contain one or more zeros.
constraints: 2 <= len(nums) <= 100000; reference outputs fit signed 64-bit integers.
hints: The contribution from the left can be precomputed as you go.
A reverse pass multiplies everything to the right.
